notes: DiscoFlate v3.47.0 — overlays go live: a new 'play overlay' ACTION TYPE in every action block (commands, capacity/timed events, polls, competitions…) plays an image or video over the virtual camera — static/timed images, looping videos, hold-until-cleared, or play-once-then-die; named layers replace each other for scene building; quietly skips when the virtual camera isn't running. Video uploads up to 96MB. Message actions can post 'as the OWNER' (webhook voice; quietly skips without Manage Webhooks). Owner-voice fix: it now wears the Dashboard Owner name (or your Discord display name) instead of accidentally posting under the bot's own name — and the Chat tab says so out loud when it ever falls back to a bot post. Snapshot tab renamed Camera (with a single-webcam heads-up while the virtual cam runs). Custom Buttons / Owner Commands / Overlay actions editor pages now lay out properly on phones.
